description: Take-home pay for an employee in United States from a gross yearly salary in USD, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 federal brackets: single, married filing jointly, head of household; Child Tax Credit with phase-out and refundable part; FICA with the 2026 wage base and Additional Medicare; 401(k) (with 50+ catch-up), HSA and section 125 pre-tax deductions; State income tax 2026 for 12 states incl. NYC with their own married-couple tables, exemptions and credits; Employee payroll programmes: CA SDI, NY PFL and DBL, NJ TDI/FLI/UI, MA and WA PFML, WA Cares.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

filing.description: Filing status (unmarried). Married people file jointly here; switch on "Married" above.: single = Single; hoh = Head of household (with a qualifying child). Default single.

fx_per_eur.description: Exchange rate: 1 euro = this many USD, for the euro amounts. Default 1.08 (indicative).

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in USD, without bonus

hsa.description: HSA contribution. Health Savings Account, 2026 limit $4,400 self-only, $8,750 family. Free of income tax and FICA through payroll. ($ / year). Default 0.

married.description: Married or registered partner. Default false.

pension_pct.description: Voluntary employee pension contribution through payroll, % of salary. Default 0.

pretax.description: Other pre-tax deductions. Employee share of health premiums, FSA, commuter benefits (section 125): free of income tax and FICA. ($ / year). Default 0.

spouse_income.description: Partner's gross yearly income in USD, for joint taxation and spouse allowances. Default 0.

state.description: State: none = No state income tax (TX, FL, NV, TN, SD, WY, AK, NH); CA = California; NY = New York (outside NYC); NYC = New York City; IL = Illinois (4.95% flat); MA = Massachusetts (5%, 9% above $1.11M); PA = Pennsylvania (3.07% flat); NJ = New Jersey; CO = Colorado (4.4% flat); NC = North Carolina (3.99% flat); GA = Georgia (4.99% flat); AZ = Arizona (2.5% flat); WA = Washington (no income tax, WA Cares + PFML). Default none.

tax_year.description: Tax year. Offered: 2026 (final), 2025 (final), 2024 (final). Default 2026. A year that is not listed is not available for this country.

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in United States (2026)
